Foundation is the immediate validation/review substrate with zero author VMs; full remains the later interactive-worker target.
One 4-vCPU/16-GiB-or-better resource-class contract. Mixed-current is available now; homogeneous Dasv6 remains optional and quota-gated.
Reviewed supervisor and immediate-pilot family. Dasv6 has 10 live vCPUs; Dasv5 is compatibility-only and remains quota-gated.
Future homogeneous Dasv6 full-profile target only. The live family allowance is 10; mixed-current production does not require this target.
Regional scheduler headroom reserved for isolated validation, policy review, browser, replacement, and ancillary capacity.
Worker slots to create or reconcile. Incremental deployment never removes omitted retained disks.
Exact reviewed SKU for each worker slot; the scheduler must reject any incompatible or undersized value.
Set only by the guarded worker-create command to admit exactly one requested worker without changing the profile-wide capacity contract.
Configurable scheduler target after real telemetry exists; it does not terminate active work.
Planning and alert threshold only, not a commissioning hard stop.
Hours inside the aggregate cap reserved for elastic validation and policy review.
First day of the current billing month in UTC.
Optional gallery image version resource id for author worker VMs; empty keeps the Canonical marketplace base. Supervisor and pilot compute never take this image.

Reviewed 4-vCPU/16-GiB-or-better one-shot validation seam. The default fits the live 10-vCPU Dasv6 allowance; another listed family still requires live quota and retail-rate proof. This template creates no runner VM.
Enable only after acceptance to add CanNotDelete locks to storage and Key Vault.
Reserved pin seam. Leave empty until the Linux artifact contract is independently verified.

Reserved integrity seam. No installer consumes it in this revision.

Optional single operator egress IPv4 (or CIDR) allowed to the storage data plane for private management. Empty keeps public network access fully disabled. Never weakens the Deny default, shared-key/public-blob disablement, or private endpoints.

variables.capacityMatches: [and(equals(length(parameters('workerSlots')), length(parameters('workerSkus'))), or(and(parameters('incrementalWorkerDeploy'), equals(length(parameters('workerSlots')), 1)), and(not(parameters('incrementalWorkerDeploy')), or(and(equals(parameters('capacityProfile'), 'foundation'), equals(length(parameters('workerSlots')), 0)), and(equals(parameters('capacityProfile'), 'commissioning'), equals(length(parameters('workerSlots')), 2)), and(equals(parameters('capacityProfile'), 'full'), equals(length(parameters('workerSlots')), 16))))))]

resources.name: [format('vm-{0}-wkr-{1}', parameters('namingPrefix'), padLeft(string(parameters('workerSlots')[copyIndex()]), 2, '0'))]
resources.tags: [union(parameters('commonTags'), createObject('firstmate-role', 'worker', 'worker-slot', string(parameters('workerSlots')[copyIndex()]), 'selected-sku', parameters('workerSkus')[copyIndex()], 'resource-class', 'author-4vcpu-16gib-trustedlaunch', 'home-binding', parameters('workerHomeBinding'), 'task-binding', parameters('workerTaskBinding'), 'invocation-binding', parameters('workerInvocationBinding'), 'snapshot-digest', parameters('workerSnapshotDigest'), 'cost-attribution', parameters('workerCostAttribution'), 'agent-capacity', 'one-task-scoped-crewmate', 'secondmate-placement', 'forbidden', 'nested-team', 'forbidden', 'lifecycle', 'disposable-compute-retained-data'))]

storageProfile.osDisk: [if(equals(parameters('workerImageId'), ''), createObject('name', format('disk-{0}-wkr-{1}-os', parameters('namingPrefix'), padLeft(string(parameters('workerSlots')[copyIndex()]), 2, '0')), 'createOption', 'FromImage', 'deleteOption', 'Delete', 'diskSizeGB', 64, 'managedDisk', createObject('storageAccountType', 'StandardSSD_LRS')), createObject('name', format('disk-{0}-wkr-{1}-os', parameters('namingPrefix'), padLeft(string(parameters('workerSlots')[copyIndex()]), 2, '0')), 'createOption', 'FromImage', 'deleteOption', 'Delete', 'managedDisk', createObject('storageAccountType', 'StandardSSD_LRS')))]

allOf.query: [format('Heartbeat | where Computer startswith ''wkr-{0}-'' | summarize LastHeartbeat=max(TimeGenerated) by Computer', parameters('namingPrefix'))]
